title: Introducing the Enhanced Spyglass Tool
summary: We are thrilled to announce the official launch of Spyglass, delivering a refined and powerful tool now fully available to elevate your experience.

title: Enhanced File Management
summary: Gain complete control over your images and documents within the editor with powerful new options for management, uploading, and customizable display.

title: Introducing the Noeko Public Roadmap!
summary: Explore our brand-new public roadmap to stay informed about our latest achievements, upcoming features, and long-term vision for Noeko.

title: Enhanced Checkboxes
summary: Our new and improved checkboxes are now effortlessly clickable and draggable, enhancing your productivity with a fresh, modern look.

title: Enhanced Real-time Collaboration
summary: Enjoy a more seamless and intuitive teamwork experience in the editor with enhanced real-time collaboration features and clearer progress indicators.

title: Effortless Shared Content Discovery
summary: Discover and access all shared ideas and quests with ease, fostering more productive and intuitive collaboration within your network.

title: Dynamic Knowledge Map
summary: Navigate your ideas with unprecedented clarity by utilizing powerful new filters and sharing features within your enhanced knowledge map.

title: Powerful Search and Personalized Knowledge Collections
summary: Unlock the full potential of your knowledge base with advanced filtering, sorting, and the ability to save custom views for quick, organized access.

title: Dynamic Content Previews
summary: Experience a more intuitive way to organize your thoughts with flexible display options for linked content, enhancing clarity and flow.

title: Noeko: Self-Hosted Freedom and Enterprise Capabilities

title: Enhanced Theme Gallery
summary: Discover a richer, more diverse selection of themes designed to personalize your workspace with beautiful new styles and perfected classics.

title: Personalized Welcome Messages
summary: We're refining our homepage greetings to always reflect the correct time of day, ensuring a perfectly personalized welcome every time you log in.
